title: Privacy notice that adds an analytics vendor while the published processor list stays as it was, and a statement template without the required sentence

planted.why: the notice now sends account data to Corvid Metrics, which is not on the published processor list the same sentence relies on
rule 4.5 requires the sentence 'Compare this information with your official account statement.' on every communication about a managed account; the template lacks it

proof.python:
assert 'Corvid' not in open('subprocessors_published.md').read()
assert 'Corvid Metrics' in open('privacy_notice.md').read()
assert 'official account statement' not in open('statement_template.md').read()
assert 'official account statement' in open('rule_extract.md').read()
